title: Add development environment setup (AGENTS.md)
body: ## Summary Adds `AGENTS.md` with Cursor Cloud specific development environment instructions for the Bilet Ekosistemi ticketing platform. ## What's included - **`AGENTS.md`**: Documents key development setup instructions including: - Use `npm run dev:turbo` (Turbopack) instead of `npm run dev` (webpack mode has a pre-existing SSR rendering bug) - Environment variable setup (`.env.example` → `.env.local`) - Lint / build / check commands - Node.js version compatibility notes - Key gotchas for future developers and cloud agents - **`package-lock.json`**: Minor lockfile update from resolved transitive dependency ## Development Environment Verification | Check | Command | Result | |-------|---------|--------| | Dependencies | `npm install` | ✅ 815 packages installed | | Lint | `npm run lint` | ✅ Passes (warnings only) | | Build | `npm run build` | ✅ All 66 pages compiled | | Dev Server | `npm run dev:turbo` | ✅ Port 3000, all routes 200 | ## Hello World Demo [hello_world_demo.mp4](https://cursor.com/agents/bc-ecc81937-a5f7-488c-93e0-1afa6353ec5c/artifacts?path=%2Fopt%2Fcursor%2Fartifacts%2Fhello_world_demo.mp4) Demonstrated core functionality: i18n language switching (TR → EN), FAQ accordion interaction, login form input, and cart page rendering — all without Supabase credentials. ### Key screenshots Language switcher dropdown: [Language switcher](https://cursor.com/agents/bc-ecc81937-a5f7-488c-93e0-1afa6353ec5c/artifacts?path=%2Fopt%2Fcursor%2Fartifacts%2Flanguage_switcher.webp) FAQ page in English after i18n switch: [FAQ in English](https://cursor.com/agents/bc-ecc81937-a5f7-488c-93e0-1afa6353ec5c/artifacts?path=%2Fopt%2Fcursor%2Fartifacts%2Ffaq_english.webp) FAQ accordion interaction: [FAQ accordion expanded](https://cursor.com/agents/bc-ecc81937-a5f7-488c-93e0-1afa6353ec5c/artifacts?path=%2Fopt%2Fcursor%2Fartifacts%2Ffaq_accordion_interaction.webp) Login form with test input: [Login form filled](https://cursor.com/agents/bc-ecc81937-a5f7-488c-93e0-1afa6353ec5c/artifacts?path=%2Fopt%2Fcursor%2Fartifacts%2Flogin_form_filled.webp) Empty cart page: [Cart page](https://cursor.com/agents/bc-ecc81937-a5f7-488c-93e0-1afa6353ec5c/artifacts?path=%2Fopt%2Fcursor%2Fartifacts%2Fcart_empty.webp) To show artifacts inline, enable in settings.
